items.title: A projected top-5 college basketball team just loss their offensive engine to a foot injury.
items.author: Hoop Informatics
items.body_excerpt:
A projected top-5 college basketball team just loss their offensive engine to a foot injury.

Illinois basketball announced that David Mirkovic had surgery on his left foot after sustaining an injury in practice and is expected to make a full recovery, although no time table was given.

images.alt: Illinois Fighting Illini graphic with a thin orange border. On the left, a duotone navy-and-orange photo of David Mirkovic in profile, wearing a navy "FIGHTING ILLINI" jersey with the number 0, arena lights blurred above him. Text on the right reads: "Sophomore forward David Mirkovic underwent successful surgery today in Indianapolis after suffering a left foot injury during a team workout in Champaign on July 31. He is expected to make a full recovery." Mirkovic's name is in orange; the rest is white. Below the text is the Illinois script logo, the block I mark, and the phrase "EVERY DAY GUYS."
